bugs.text: Challenging stage (stage 3) soft-locks: only wave 0 is spawned; nextWaveTimer is set but never counted down and spawnChallengeWave is never called again, and the stage-clear check (1714) is disabled while challenging, so after the first 8 enemies the screen stays empty for ever. The game cannot progress past stage 3.

Entering enemies fire aimed bullets at the player every 0.2-1.2 s then 0.7-2.2 s each while between y 20 and 200; with 40 enemies entering in five groups this is roughly ten aimed shots a second at every stage start, and respawn does not stop it (only new dives are blocked, 1330). In the play-test the first ship was lost within 5 s, the second by 8 s (screenshots 2 and 3, red bullets everywhere), and three whole games ended in 75 s with scores of 460-1310.

Boss escorts dive with NaN coordinates: startDive reads followBossDive.x1/.cx/.cy, fields the dive object does not have, so the escort Goei is invisible and unhittable for its whole dive and return (its x/y are NaN until the snap at 1449-1451). It still counts for the 800/1600 boss bonus and its bullets are NaN objects that are never culled (1209) and accumulate.
Formation never sways or breathes: game.formation.time is never incremented, so every sin() term is 0 and the formation is static.
Tractor-beam capture plays the player explosion and spawns an explosion instead of pulling the ship up and turning it red; the captive then appears instantly above the boss.
Challenge-wave enemies whose start offset lies beyond the -24/W+24 cull (2-3 per wave) are removed on their first update tick, so a full 8-hit wave bonus and PERFECT are impossible.
Stage badge is a single rounded-down denomination with one flag, not the arcade's composed set (stage 7 shows just '5').
Ramming a full-HP Boss only damages it instead of destroying it.
Enemy hit/ram boxes are 16 px tall while Boss and Goei sprites are drawn 10 px tall, so the player's ship can be destroyed by an enemy that is not visibly touching it.
playEnemyDestroyed is never called; enemy hit and enemy destroyed share one sound.
During GAME OVER enemies and enemy bullets freeze mid-air (seen in screenshot 5-end) instead of continuing or clearing.
Top HUD label reads 'HIGH' rather than 'HIGH SCORE'.

summary: The code is cleanly organised: one state object, separate update and render passes, a proper accumulator loop, data-defined sprites and a pixel font, and most of the spec's systems (two-shot limit, extra ships, beam, capture, rescue, dual fighter, captive fire, stage flow, sounds, localStorage) are wired and reachable. It is let down by three untested paths: the challenging stage spawns only its first wave and then soft-locks the game at stage 3, boss escorts dive on NaN coordinates and vanish, and the formation's sway/breathe clock is never advanced. The biggest playability problem is tuning rather than a crash: forty entering enemies each firing aimed shots on a sub-two-second cadence turn every stage start into a bullet hell, and the play-test lost all three ships in well under half a minute per game. Visually it reads as a Galaga-like (blue/yellow bees, red butterflies, green bosses that turn blue, a widening blue beam, READY and GAME OVER screens, a score table) but the sprites are simple ovals with a one-pixel bob instead of wing flaps, the formation is static, and capture is an explosion rather than a pull-up, so it feels like a competent sketch of Galaga rather than a faithful one.
